suggestion.to: We were one of the international partners on JAXA’s AKARI infrared satellite, alongside Nagoya University, the University of Tokyo, ESA and other UK institutions. We used its all-sky infrared survey and spectra to study interstellar dust, polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons and the earliest star formation in galaxies: part of the cosmic chemical cycle that eventually leads to habitable worlds.
